[[File:Unidentified_Naboo_lake_2.png|thumb|265px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in the [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] veranda overlooking the lake.]]
This '''lake''' in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] was where [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]], home of the celebrated [[Poet/Legends|poet]] [[Omar Berenko/Legends|Omar Berenko]] and later the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family]], was located.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Convergence/Legends|Convergence]], the ancestral home of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]], was built at the end of a vast stretch of meadow near the shore, at some distance from Varykino, and one of its verandas offered a view of the lake.<ref name="DPN">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

According to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], when she was in [[School|Level Three]], the class used Varikyno as a school retreat, and the children would often swim to a small island across the lake.<ref name="AOTCn">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lake filmed in Episode II is [[Lake Como]] in [[Wikipedia:Italy|Italy]]. The Varykino scenes were filmed at the [[Villa del Balbianello]] overlooking the lake.
